Prerequisites: —

Once per enemy, if the engineer successfully hits a construct in combat, he may use his Disable Device class skill to damage, destroy, or shutdown a construct, such as a golem, effigy, or construct. The DC for this check 20 + the creature's HD. For every 5 points that he beats the DC of this check by, he may reduce the construct's HD by 1. The engineer always reduce at least 1 HD if he successfully makes the check. If he manages to reduce the construct to zero HD, he may choose to either deactivate it, leaving it intact but inactive, or he may choose to destroy it. If he is using a ranged weapon in combat to strike the construct, he must be within 30 feet to target it properly for this ability to work.
